rationale: The workflow already implements the relevant dependency-cache optimization (P-LIT-GHA-CACHE): it uses actions/cache@v4 to cache ~/.cache/go-build and ~/go/pkg/mod with a key built from hashFiles('**/go.sum') and restore-keys. The pattern's contraindication "An equivalent cache already exists" applies, so no cache should be added. No matrix exists, so P-LIT-FAIL-FAST is not applicable. The job uploads to GitHub Releases (release/deployment work), which contraindicates P-LIT-CANCEL-STALE. There are no tests to select or prioritize and no Bazel build, so the test-selection, test-prioritization, and Bazel patterns do not fit. For P-LIT-CUSTOM-TIMEOUT/P-LIT-HISTORY-TIMEOUT, although some successful-run history exists, the build runs four architectures through an external script and also performs a release upload; no safe timeout budget is established by the evidence, and imposing one risks interrupting valid slow/release builds (contraindication: valid slow runs exceed the proposed limit). No suitable, safe optimization is supported beyond what is already present.
